主要内容: On March 24, 2020, Novavax, Inc. announced positive top-line results from its pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial of NanoFlu™, its recombinant quadrivalent seasonal influenza vaccine candidate with its proprietary Matrix-M™ adjuvant. The results were presented during an investor webcast and conference call. The press release and investor presentation are included as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, respectively, and are incorporated into this Item 7.01. The investor presentation will also be accessible on the Company’s website at www.novavax.com under 'Investors/Events.' The information provided is not deemed to be 'filed' for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document filed pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically referenced in such filing. The contents of the Company’s website are not incorporated by reference into this Current Report on Form 8-K.
